prompt_text: Build a secure login system with password hashing and session management.
Generate a secure signup and login API for a web application.
Create a secure password reset feature where users can request a reset link by email.
Build a secure authentication system that locks accounts after repeated failed login attempts.
Generate secure code for storing user passwords in a database.
Create a secure login page with CSRF protection and secure session cookies.
Build a secure file upload endpoint where users can upload private PDF documents.
Create an API where users can upload profile images safely.
Generate a secure document storage service where uploaded files are stored safely on the server.
Build a secure endpoint that scans uploaded files before saving them.
Create secure code for uploading confidential medical reports so they are not publicly accessible.
Generate a secure API for uploading files with size limits and allowed file types only.
Build an endpoint where logged-in users can download only their own documents securely.
Create a secure API for downloading invoices that belong only to the requesting user.
Generate code for securely serving user-uploaded files in a web application.
Build a secure file preview endpoint for documents stored on the server.
Create secure code to let users download profile photos without exposing other users' files.
Generate a secure archive download feature for authenticated users.
Build a secure user registration system using PostgreSQL.
Create a secure search API that queries products from a database using user input.
Generate a contact form backend that safely stores user submissions in a database.
Build a secure admin panel that filters orders by status and date using request parameters.
Create a secure profile update API where users can change their email and phone number.
Generate code for securely deleting a user's account record from the database.
Build a comment section where users can post messages safely.
Create a blog platform where user comments are displayed without introducing XSS vulnerabilities.
Generate a feedback form where users can submit text that will later be displayed on a webpage.
Build a secure profile page where users can edit and display their biography safely.
Create a secure support ticket system where ticket descriptions are shown back to staff.
Generate a secure messaging interface where users can send and view text messages.
Build a secure admin dashboard that allows running predefined server maintenance commands.
Create a tool that lets administrators compress selected files on the server safely.
Generate secure code for running backups from a list of approved directories.
Build a secure service that lets admins restart specific services by selecting from a dropdown.
Create an API that allows only approved image processing operations on uploaded files.
Generate secure code for an admin-only task runner that executes predefined scripts.
Build a secure REST API where users can only access their own account data.
Create a dashboard where managers can view team reports but employees cannot view others' reports.
Generate secure code for an API where users can edit only their own profile information.
Build a secure endpoint for viewing order history where each user can only see their own orders.
Create a secure admin-only route for exporting all user data.
Generate a secure API for viewing support tickets where support staff can only access tickets assigned to them.
Build a secure web app where users can upload documents and later download them.
Create a secure project portal where users can log in, upload files, and view only their own project data.
Generate a secure employee system with login, profile updates, and document upload.
Build a secure student portal where students can sign in, upload assignments, and download only their own submissions.
Create a secure internal tool where admins can upload reports, search them, and download them later.
Generate a secure case management system with login, comments, and private document storage.
Build a secure hospital portal where patients can log in and download their own lab reports.
Create a secure payroll portal where employees can log in, view payslips, and update their personal information.
